project_data_structure.description: Complete structure of data saved in user_projects.project_data column

eeat.description: Expertise, Experience, Authority, Trustworthiness audit results
eeat.dataType: Object with score, rating, sections, checks

semantic.dataType: Object with entities, seoScore, imageAlts, hyperlinks

robots.description: Robots.txt file analysis and compliance check

speed.description: PageSpeed Insights metrics (LCP, FCP, CLS, mobile/desktop scores)
speed.dataType: Object with cwv array, mobile/desktop scores

gsc.description: Google Search Console metrics (clicks, impressions, CTR, position)

bing.description: Bing Webmaster metrics (clicks, impressions, CTR, position)

backlinks.dataType: Object with totalBacklinks, referringDomains, backlinks array

crawlOptimization.dataType: Object with low, clean, medium, high priority counts

llmsTxt.description: Generated LLMs.txt content for AI model compatibility

branded-keywords.description: Branded keywords tracked for keyword cannibalization analysis

contentWriter_articles.description: Articles created by the content writer AI tool

contentWriter_state.description: Current state of content writer editor
contentWriter_state.dataType: Object with editor state, current article, etc.

onpage_analysis.dataType: Object with title, meta, headings, keywords, readability

fields.scope: string - Crawl scope (subdomains, directory, domain, exact)
fields.ownerUid: string - User ID of project owner
fields.renderJs: boolean - Whether JavaScript rendering is enabled
fields.createdAt: string - ISO timestamp of project creation
fields.notifyEmail: boolean - Whether to send email notifications
fields.respectRobots: boolean - Whether to respect robots.txt rules

commonStructure.description: Common structure for all tool results

fields.result: object - The actual tool result data
fields.ownerUid: string - User ID who ran the tool
fields.ownerEmail: string - Email of user who ran the tool
fields.projectUrl: string - URL of the project being analyzed
fields.updatedAt: string - Timestamp when result was saved

notes.note1: Most tool results are stored under $.toolResults.{toolKey}
notes.note2: Some tools have legacy paths for backward compatibility (see legacyPath fields)
notes.note3: LLMs.txt is stored at $.llmsTxt (NOT nested in toolResults)
notes.note4: Content writer and keyword data are stored at root level, not in toolResults
notes.note5: Each tool result wrapper includes ownerUid, ownerEmail, projectUrl, and updatedAt
notes.note6: Total of 14 registered tool keys in TOOL_RESULT_KEYS
notes.note7: Additional custom data can be stored at root level using saveProjectData API
